Container.Name: OpenFamily-Server
Container.Overview: API server for OpenFamily, a family organizer: shared calendar, tasks and chores with a kids rewards system, shopping lists, meal planning and recipes, family budget, kiosk mode and an optional AI assistant. English and French interface.[br][br] OpenFamily is a three-container app. Install in this order:[br] 1. A PostgreSQL 16 container from Community Applications (e.g. "postgresql16"). Create a dedicated database and user for OpenFamily - no need to import anything, this container creates its own tables on first start.[br] 2. This container (the API server).[br] 3. The OpenFamily-Client container (the web interface - this is what you open in the browser).[br][br] Generate JWT_SECRET with: openssl rand -hex 32 (the server refuses to start with a short or placeholder secret).
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL 16 container (from CA) with an empty database and user created for OpenFamily (see Overview), and the OpenFamily-Client container as the web entry point.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Container Port: 3001 (REST API + WebSocket, consumed by the OpenFamily-Client container)

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Host
Config.Description: IP or hostname of your PostgreSQL container, e.g. 192.168.1.50

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Password
Config.Description: Container Variable: POSTGRES_PASSWORD (required - the server refuses to start in production without it)

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Random secret used to sign sessions, minimum 32 characters (48+ recommended). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Allow Registration
Config.Description: Set to false to disable new account creation once the family is set up

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated allowed origins. Not needed for the default setup (all traffic is same-origin through the OpenFamily-Client proxy); only set when calling the API from another origin.

Config.Name: Server Port (internal)
Config.Description: Container Variable: SERVER_PORT (leave at 3001 unless you also change the port mapping)
